failed_initial_prototype: Initial version missed the absolute hardware readlane probability broadcast and corrupted every second logical head. All its timings were excluded. Corrected subgroup shuffle and paired-readlane variants passed exact comparisons.
prototype_edits: Keep logical kWave=32; compile the candidate translation unit with -mwavefrontsize64.
Use the logical threadIdx.x/32 head index without hardware readfirstlane.
Uniform(value) returns the subgroup-uniform value without broadcasting from hardware lane 0.
For each probability broadcast, read hardware lane key and key+32; select by threadIdx.x & 32.
Change the R=4 amdgpu_waves_per_eu minimum from 8 to 4 to preserve the requested logical-wave occupancy.
The isolated combined microbenchmark compiles both attention partials and merge in each native wave mode.
The temporary production dispatch uses the request stream and restricts rows/context as recorded; it has been removed.

standard_benchmark.scope: 31B UD-Q4_K_XL + Q8_0 assistant, C1, request calibration, pp2048 and tg128 at d16384; one repetition per arm, single pair, inconclusive timing control.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
for arm in base candidate; do
  /tmp/gufo-wave64/gufo-${arm} bench \
    --model /home/franz/models/gemma-4/gemma-31b-it/gemma-4-31B-it-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf \
    --speculative mtp \
    --mtp-model /home/franz/models/gemma-4/drafts/31b-assistant/gemma-4-31B-it-assistant.Q8_0.gguf \
    --draft-calibration request \
    -p 2048 -n 128 -d 16384 -r 1 \
    > /tmp/gufo-wave64/bench-${arm}.log 2>&1
  echo "completed ${arm} standard benchmark"
done
